title: The repository's own `nvs.toml` explains itself with ADR sections, not the `rule:` ids that state them.
text: The comments from `nvs.toml:1` on cite `ADR 0103 § 1 step 2`, `ADR 0104 § 1`, `ADR 0118 § 2`, `ADR 0131 § 3` and others. A decision record is frozen rationale, and the rule fragment is what is currently true. Closing this rewrites each citation as the `rule:` id that states it, for example `rule:config/the-root-is-config-else-nvs-toml-else-the-shipped-defaults` for step 2.
